Perfect! After Rxe5, Black is clearly winning (up a queen for bishop and pawn). Black can even give checks with Rxg2+.

**Best move:** Bxd4+

**Main line:** Bxd4+ cxd4 Rxg6 Ne5+ dxe5 Rxe5

**Motif:** fork (the bishop check forks king and pawn, winning material)

**Coaching note:** When your opponent's heavy pieces are far from defense, look for forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) that exploit it. Here, Bxd4+ forces White to recapture, then your rook captures the undefended queen. The pin-like control of the queen—trapped between your rook and unable to escape—is the key. Always calculate forcing lines to the end before moving.
